finding: A pure function repeated N times is one Bernoulli trial. The miss bound uses effectiveRuns, not the copy count.

deterministic_gate.boundNote: identical pure-function runs are one trial; naiveMissedRate95 illegally divides by the copy count

mitigation: Tag each check deterministic or stochastic before applying missedRate95. Do not buy a tighter bound by repeating a script that cannot flip.
